QNX SDP 8.0 supports only 64-bit targets (x86_64 and aarch64le); it dropped 32-bit ARMv7 (armv7le) and x86. Switching the target for you would change the binary's architecture, so I won't do it silently. Your options: (1) If the board is 64-bit ARM (ARMv8/AArch64), build with `qcc -Vgcc_ntoaarch64le -o hello hello.c`. (2) For an x86_64 target, use `-Vgcc_ntox86_64`. explained: The code can't be built as written because QNX SDP 8.0 does not support SA_RESTART. In $QNX_TARGET/usr/include/signal.h (line 163) the definition is commented out: '/* #define SA_RESTART 0x0040 (not supported yet) */'. This is not a missing include, compiler flag or environment problem. Defining SA_RESTART yourself (for example -DSA_RESTART=0x40) would compile, but the kernel would not restart interrupted calls, so the code would be quietly wrong. Change the source instead: (1) drop SA_RESTART and retry calls that fail with errno == EINTR, e.g. do { r = read(...); } while (r == -1 && errno == EINTR); or (2) block the signal with sigprocmask/pthread_sigmask and handle it synchronously with sigwaitinfo() in a dedicated thread, so blocking calls are never interrupted. If you only need the example to compile with no flags, use sa.sa_flags = 0.

explained: Architecture mismatch, and none of the available fix actions can rebuild a binary. `file` shows ./hello is 'ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, ARM aarch64 ... interpreter /usr/lib/ldqnx-64.so.2'. But qnx-doctor-target-run always builds an x86_64 QEMU image ('mkqnximage --type=qemu --arch=x86_64'). The x86_64 QNX kernel can't exec an aarch64 ELF, so ksh falls back to treating the file as a shell script. That produces the 'ELF...: cannot execute' and 'no closing quote' errors. The SDP and environment are fine. Fix: rebuild hello for x86_64 from the working directory with `qcc -Vgcc_ntox86_64 -o hello hello.c` (or `ntox86_64-gcc -o hello hello.c`), then re-run `qnx-doctor-target-run ./hello`. If you need to run on aarch64 instead, you'd need an aarch64 target or image (mkqnximage --arch=aarch64le), which this runner script doesn't support without changing it.
